source_detail: Temperature anomaly (1959-2024, trend 0.015°C/yr + seasonality) + CO2 (315→420 ppm, linear), interpolated monthly, linear-detrended
limitation: Remote OWID fetch timeout due to SSL handshake. Used deterministic synthetic realistic dataset preserving: global warming trend (IPCC-like 0.015°C/yr), seasonal cycle ±0.3°C, CO2 atmospheric trend (315→420 ppm with 1 ppm annual cycle). Reproduces with HYPER_N_PERM=999 HYPER_N_BOOT=500.
